name: Sum of Shared Single Effects (SuShiE)
model_likelihood: Ancestry-specific linear regressions of centered standardized molecular traits on genotypes with Gaussian residual noise.
prior: Sum of L shared single effects; multinomial single-variant indicators with probabilities pi and zero-mean multivariate Gaussian ancestry-specific effects with effect-specific covariance C_l.
inference_algorithm: CAVI surrogate posterior; alternating Empirical Bayes-like ELBO updates of variational factors, residual variances and effect covariances.
estimand: Per-effect variant probabilities; SNP PIPs; credible sets; ancestry-specific posterior effects and covariances; prior effect-size correlations.
data_input: Genotype matrices and molecular traits from multiple ancestries, or summary statistics.
tunable_settings: Number of effects L; variant prior probabilities pi; credible-set probability eta; purity threshold (0.5 in paper); initialization values for effects, effect covariance and residual variance.
